title: Publish a current-generation retrieval evaluation
objective: The current product has a reproducible relevance and coverage report.
outcome: Evaluator and result identities pin corpus, generation, ranking code, vocabulary, question split and reviewer-label identity. The historical 143-record v1.0.1 baseline is retained separately. Comparisons reject mismatched cohorts or generations rather than reporting misleading improvements. Present-source recall@10, precision@5, full-universe recall, forbidden results, named-source misses, uncertainty and per-domain outcomes report denominators. Known absent sources reduce full-universe coverage; they do not silently vanish. Machine-readable results and a Methods report keep raw rankings and adjudication notes. R07 remains incomplete: a failing domain has a bounded remediation task instead of a passing summary. Producer tests and independent reviewer labels are reported separately. Held-out labels stay outside producer scoring. Fingerprint-sealed question-parser.mjs, retrieval-core-v1.2.mjs and controlled-vocabulary.json are not edited. Historical EVALUATION.md metrics are not overwritten.
